title: THE CELLAR
intro: YOU WAKE UP IN A DARK CELLAR. A RAT IS WATCHING YOU. FIRST, MAKE SOME LIGHT.

player.name: ARIN
player.desc: ARIN, A YOUNG ADVENTURER. DRAG THINGS INTO THE INVENTORY, DROP ONE ITEM ON ANOTHER TO COMBINE THEM, OR DROP AN ITEM ON ME TO USE IT.

items.name: STICK
items.desc: A DRY STICK. IT WOULD BURN WELL.

items.name: CLOTH
items.desc: AN OLD RAG.

items.name: RAG STICK
items.desc: A STICK WRAPPED IN CLOTH. IT NEEDS SOMETHING TO SOAK IT.

items.name: OIL
items.desc: A SMALL FLASK OF LAMP OIL.

items.name: TORCH
items.desc: A BURNING TORCH. NOW YOU CAN SEE.

items.name: KEY
items.desc: A SMALL IRON KEY.

items.name: GOLD
items.desc: A HEAVY PILE OF GOLD COINS!

items.name: BONE
items.desc: WHAT IS LEFT OF THE RAT'S DINNER.

items.name: APPLE
items.desc: A RED, JUICY APPLE.

items.name: CHEST
items.desc: A HEAVY CHEST. IT IS LOCKED.

items.name: OPEN CHEST
items.desc: THE CHEST IS OPEN.

items.name: RAT
items.desc: A BIG GREY RAT. IT LOOKS HUNGRY.

items.name: DOOR
items.desc: A WOODEN DOOR.

items.name: TABLE
items.desc: AN OLD OAK TABLE.

items.name: CRANK
items.desc: A RUSTY IRON CRANK HANDLE.

items.name: WINCH
items.desc: A WINCH FOR THE GATE. ITS HANDLE IS MISSING.

items.name: WINCH
items.desc: THE WINCH, WITH ITS CRANK FITTED.

items.name: GATE
items.desc: A HEAVY IRON GATE. IT IS SHUT.

items.name: OPEN GATE
items.desc: THE GATE IS OPEN. THE WILDERNESS LIES BEYOND.

items.name: PATH
items.desc: A NARROW PATH BETWEEN THE TREES.

items.name: TRAIL
items.desc: YOUR OWN TRACKS, BACK TO THE GATE.

rooms.name: CELLAR
rooms.desc: A DAMP CELLAR. A DOOR LEADS UP TO THE HALL.

rooms.name: HALL
rooms.desc: A BRIGHT HALL WITH TWO WINDOWS. STAIRS LEAD DOWN TO THE CELLAR.

rooms.name: THE GATES
rooms.desc: A HIGH WALL WITH A HEAVY IRON GATE. A WINCH STANDS BESIDE IT.

door.locked: THE GATE IS SHUT. THERE MUST BE A WAY TO OPEN IT.

rooms.name: WILDERNESS
rooms.desc: TREES, BUSHES AND MORE TREES. EVERY WAY LOOKS THE SAME.

do.text: YOU WRAP THE CLOTH AROUND THE STICK.
THE RAT SNIFFS THE APPLE, GRABS IT AND RUNS AWAY. IT LEAVES A BONE.
YOU WRAP THE CLOTH AROUND THE STICK.
YOU SOAK THE RAG IN OIL AND IT CATCHES FIRE FROM A SPARK. A TORCH!
YOU SOAK THE RAG IN OIL AND IT CATCHES FIRE FROM A SPARK. A TORCH!
THE KEY TURNS. THE CHEST OPENS... SOMETHING GLITTERS INSIDE!
YOU WHACK THE RAT.
IT BITES YOU BACK!
THE RAT IS AFRAID OF FIRE!
THE RAT IS NOT INTERESTED IN BONES.
YOU HIT THE RAT.
IT BITES YOU BACK!
THE RAT SQUEAKS AND RUNS AWAY. IT DROPPED A BONE.
IN THE TORCHLIGHT YOU SPOT SOMETHING ON THE FLOOR!
IT IS TOO DARK TO SEARCH. YOU NEED SOME LIGHT.
YOU EAT THE APPLE. YOU FEEL BETTER.
OUCH! THAT'S HOT.
YOU ARE NOT THAT HUNGRY.
YOU TAKE THE GOLD. NOW FIND A WAY OUT OF HERE!
YOU FUMBLE IN THE DARK BUT CANNOT FIND THE LATCH.
YOU FIT THE CRANK AND TURN IT. WITH A LOUD CREAK THE GATE SWINGS OPEN!
UNDER THE TABLE YOU FIND AN IRON CRANK.
YOU WANDER AIMLESSLY... THESE TREES LOOK FAMILIAR.
YOU WALK FOR HOURS, BUT END UP RIGHT WHERE YOU STARTED.
